prompt: Describe version control branching. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any punctuation marks. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Must be written as a single continuous line of text.
evaluation_criteria:
Punctuation Exclusion: 0-5 (Evaluates zero punctuation)
Single Line: 0-5 (Evaluates absence of newlines)
response_text: branching in version control is a method where you create an independent copy of a repository allowing developers to work on features or fixes simultaneously without disrupting the main codebase which is later merged back together when the work is complete
